# Country scope. Active overseas colonial power eligible for Chartered Company events.
oe_col3_is_chartered_company_power = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	has_ports = yes
	OR = {
		has_law = oe_col3_chartered_company_law
		has_colonial_charters = yes
		any_owned_location = { is_overseas_for_owner = yes }
		any_subject = { is_colonial_subject = yes }
	}
}

# Country scope. Late-game (1700-1836) imperial metropole with significant overseas holdings or colonial subjects.

	is_rebel_country = no

	OR = {
